item.title: Self-Hosted RTK GPS Base Stations: RTKLIB vs RTKBase vs CentipedeRTK for Centimeter-Accurate Positioning
item.description: Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS delivers centimeter-level positioning accuracy — a massive leap from the 3–5 meter accuracy of standard GPS. Whether you’re surveying land, guiding autonomous tractors, or building drone navigation systems, an RTK base station is the foundation. The good news? You can run your own self-hosted RTK base station on affordable single-board computers like the Raspberry Pi, with open-source software that rivals commercial systems costing thousands of dollars.
